question.text: The core assumption of technical analysis is that:

answer.text: Intrinsic value always differs from price
All information affecting a stock is already reflected in its price

explanation.text: The Logic: Technicians assume all info is in the price; patterns reveal sentiment/future moves. The Trap: Other statements contradict core tenets. Cross-Exam Context: Same in XV (RA) and XIII (Derivatives). Distributor's Pro-Tip: TA is a short-term timing tool; don't use it as sole basis for long PMS holdings.
